audience: courier operations teams with customer-authorized e-Courier API access

useCases.title: Check a delivery order
useCases.text: Read shipment status, pickup/delivery stops and tracking details without changing the courier job.

useCases.title: Quote a delivery
useCases.text: Check price and availability for a customer with pickup/delivery addresses and optional parcel details. No job is created.

useCases.title: Review a driver’s current work
useCases.text: Inspect orders assigned to a driver and read the driver’s manifest.

useCases.title: Find customer shipping addresses
useCases.text: Find a customer record and its saved ship-to addresses. Only retrieve records authorized for your AI service.

useCases.title: Review invoice details
useCases.text: List invoices in a date range and inspect their fee lines. No billing or payment changes are exposed.
